name: agent-utilities
description: Reusable local utility skills for routed developer-environment maintenance, tool ownership, memory curation, configuration, and persistent-state maintenance.

interface.shortDescription: Utilities for local agent environments and state.
interface.longDescription: A personal local plugin for reusable agent utility workflows. It uses maintain-dev-env as the single developer-environment skill for Java/JDK, Maven, mvnd, mise-managed developer CLIs, and other local toolchains, including scoped trust of reviewed project mise configs that the current task changed. It loads platform, runtime, or tool-registry workflows from bundled references only when needed. It also supports structure-aware Codex memory audits and safe ad-hoc memory change requests without directly modifying generated memory state.
defaultPrompt: Use maintain-dev-env as the single skill for Java/JDK, Maven, mvnd, mise-managed developer CLIs, and other local developer environment audits, setup, repair, and task-blocking toolchain issues; when the current task changed a reviewed project mise config, trust only that config before verifying the blocked command.
Use curate-codex-memory to audit generated Codex memory state, review noisy or unsafe entries, and preview authorized ad-hoc change notes without directly editing generated memory files.
